description: This file defines the AstRuntime class in the JmesPath namespace, which interprets an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) for executing JMESPath expressions against input data. It manages parsing expressions, caching ASTs, and utilizing an interpreter to evaluate data based on expressions.

classes.name: AstRuntime
classes.description: A class responsible for interpreting a JMESPath abstract syntax tree (AST) and executing search expressions on data, with internal caching mechanisms.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser, interpreter, and sets up the function dispatcher, with optional dependencies.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes a JMESPath expression against provided data, caching compiled ASTs for performance.
